_comment: Tiny-chat rungs lost to VM replacement (PREREGISTRATION.md amendment 1: 'A rung lost to a replaced VM is recorded as lost and never imputed'). Before paperkiln 11fc9317 (25 Oct 2026 09:49 +1100) rung snapshots lived only on the VM that took them, so a replacement VM failed every unscored rung job of a run it resumed. Each of these has no rung.json; analyze.py's rung_analysis counts it as missing (the INCOMPLETE rule: fewer than max(8, 80%) runs with the rung). From 11fc9317 on, snapshots come home and go back to a replacement VM.
